title: One TSA Eight Five Five (COR One Sixty Seven)
style: registration ledger anthem, 86 bpm, deadpan plate-recital rap, terminal core, operator-side errand vibe, dry kick, sparse pad, COR one-sixty-seven signature, board-holds-the-row groove
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
COR one sixty seven WA Transport infringement
One hundred dollars overdue plates return ringing
One T S A eight five five the plate
April eighteen filing the row before the date

[Pre-Chorus]
Return notice on the registration line
Operator side action no agent design

[Chorus]
One T S A eight five five one T S A eight five five
The plate the row the overdue dive
WA Transport hundred dollar pin
The ledger holds the plate within

[Verse 2]
Not a code task not a deploy gap
Operator side errand on the map
Filed in Linear so it isn't lost
The board holds the row at no cost

[Bridge]
Not every row is the lane to fix
Some are operator action in the mix

[Outro]
One T S A eight five five filed and held
The ledger doesn't forget what's spelled
